scripts.clean: npm run clean:nuget && npm run clean:di && npm run clean:dc && npm run clean:dv && npm run clean:dve
scripts.build: npm run build:di && npm run build:dc && npm run build:dv && npm run build:dve
scripts.test: npm run build && cd Dink.Tests && dotnet test
scripts.try:dcx: npm run build:di && npm run build:dc && DinkCompiler/bin/Debug/net8.0/osx-arm64/DinkCompiler --project ../examples/test-js/dink-src/dink.dinkproj --ignoreWritingStatus --dinkStructure --stats --localization --recordingScript --origins
scripts.try:dvx: npm run build:di && npm run build:dv && DinkViewer/bin/Debug/net8.0/osx-arm64/DinkViewer --project ../examples/test-js/dink-src/dink.dinkproj --pdf
scripts.try:dct: npm run build:di && npm run build:dc && DinkCompiler/bin/Debug/net8.0/osx-arm64/DinkCompiler --project ../tests/test1/dink.dinkproj --ignoreWritingStatus --dinkStructure --stats --localization --recordingScript --origins
scripts.try:dvt: npm run build:di && npm run build:dv && DinkViewer/bin/Debug/net8.0/osx-arm64/DinkViewer --project ../tests/test1/dink.dinkproj
scripts.upgrade:simplevclib: dotnet package search wildwinter.SimpleVCLib --exact-match --format json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); const pkgs=d.searchResult[0].packages; const v=pkgs[pkgs.length-1].version; ['Directory.Build.props'].forEach(f=>{const s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'); require('fs').writeFileSync(f,s.replace(/wildwinter\.SimpleVCLib\" Version=\"[^\"]+\"/,'wildwinter.SimpleVCLib\" Version=\"'+v+'\"'));console.log(f+' -> '+v);})"
scripts.upgrade:localiserlib: dotnet package search wildwinter.LocaliserLib --exact-match --format json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); const pkgs=d.searchResult[0].packages; const v=pkgs[pkgs.length-1].version; ['DinkCompiler/DinkCompiler.csproj'].forEach(f=>{const s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'); require('fs').writeFileSync(f,s.replace(/wildwinter\.LocaliserLib\" Version=\"[^\"]+\"/,'wildwinter.LocaliserLib\" Version=\"'+v+'\"'));console.log(f+' -> '+v);})"
scripts.upgrade-nuget: dotnet nuget locals http-cache --clear && npm run upgrade:simplevclib && npm run upgrade:localiserlib && cd DinkCompiler && dotnet restore
